claude.sample_unit: Cochrane oncology plain language summaries (each generated with 3 prompts)

links.outcome: Reading level (SMOG) of original vs ChatGPT-generated plain language summaries
links.effect: Original PLS median SMOG 13.1; ChatGPT prompt 1 median 8.2, prompt 3 8.7, prompt 2 (emotional) 11.4; all still above sixth-grade target.
links.quote: PLSs generated by the first prompt (write at SMOG index 6) were the easiest to read, with the median SMOG index of 8.2 (95% CI 8‐8.4), and the shortest.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of original patient-facing summaries versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Original Cochrane oncology PLSs had median SMOG 13.1, far above sixth-grade level; ChatGPT versions 8.2-11.4 remained above target of 6.
links.quote: The median SMOG index of the PLSs generated through prompt 1, while higher than the targeted level of 6, was still significantly lower than that of the original PLSs authored by researchers (median SMOG index 13.1).

links.outcome: Effect of prompt framing (emotional vs simplicity) on readability of generated text
links.effect: Emotional-tone prompt raised SMOG from 8.2 to 11.4 versus the plain prompt; prompt 3 gave 8.7 with linguistic characteristics not different from prompt 1.
links.quote: The second prompt, which aimed to make the summaries contain text with more emotionally positive content, resulted in an increase in SMOG index and a notable shift toward analytical and clout tones, indicating that the addition of emotional language might inadvertently increase linguistic complexity.

links.outcome: Consistency of conclusiveness category between ChatGPT PLS and original scientific abstract
links.effect: Conclusiveness category of all 3 ChatGPT-generated PLSs did not differ from that of the original scientific abstract (275 summaries per prompt).
links.quote: The category of conclusiveness of all 3 ChatGPT-generated PLSs did not differ from that of the original scientific abstract ( Figure 2 ).

unlisted_practices: Prompting LLM with target readability level (SMOG 6) to simplify plain language summaries

openai.sample_unit: Cochrane oncology systematic review abstract/PLS pairs

links.effect: Prompt 1 median SMOG 8.2 (95% CI 8-8.4) vs original 13.1 (95% CI 12.9-13.4).
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated PLSs using the first prompt (SMOG index 6) were the shortest and easiest to read, with a median SMOG score of 8.2 (95% CI 8-8.4), compared with the original PLSs (median SMOG score 13.1, 95% CI 12.9-13.4).

links.effect: Prompt 1 remained above the targeted SMOG level 6; original PLS median SMOG was 13.1.
links.quote: The median SMOG index of the PLSs generated through prompt 1, while higher than the targeted level of 6, was still significantly lower than that of the original PLSs authored by researchers (median SMOG index 13.1).

links.effect: All 3 ChatGPT-generated PLS categories did not differ from original scientific abstracts.
links.quote: The category of conclusiveness of all 3 ChatGPT-generated PLSs did not differ from that of the original scientific abstract ( Figure 2 ).

unlisted_practices: Using ChatGPT-4 to rewrite Cochrane scientific abstracts into plain language summaries.
